Definition: from a compound of G1722 and G1210 (in the sense of lacking); deficient in:--lacking.
BiblicalUsage: In the early church neither was there any among them that lacked in Acts 4:34 — those with lands and houses sold them and brought the prices, so that need was met from plenty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a church where no one lacks is not a dream but a pattern, and it starts with open hands, not full storehouses.
